def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find patches of the objects in the query
    patches = [image_patch.find(object_name) for object_name in query.split()]

    # Filter out empty patches
    patches = [patch for patch in patches if patch]

    # If no patches were found, return a message indicating so
    if not patches:
        return "No patches were found in the image."

    # Sort patches by the median depth
    patches.sort(key=lambda patch: patch.compute_depth())

    # Get the patch with the highest depth
    highest_depth_patch = patches[-1]

    # Use the llm_query method to answer the query
    answer = highest_depth_patch.llm_query(query, long_answer=False)

    return answer
